verdict.rationale: Intercom's changelog documents a first-party export feature: "Export a saved View exactly as you see it". That is direct export capability, but it covers only a saved view, and the evidence names no format and no full-account scope. Paginated API list endpoints and MCP data access are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit. Migration messaging is about importing into Intercom, not leaving. missing for 10: full-account export of all data (conversations, contacts, knowledge, Fin configuration), documented open export formats (CSV/JSON), offboarding/data-portability documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export a saved View exactly as you see it
